data.name: Kristos
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘chrēstos’, meaning ‘useful, serviceable, or anointed one’. In Christian tradition, the name Kristos is used as a translation of the Hebrew name ‘Messiah’ or ‘Christ’.

in_hebrew.name: כריסטוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כריסטוס הוא השם העברי-יווני המשמש לתיאור ישוע המשיח, מלך המשיחים הנוצרים, מושיע וישוע. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'χριστός' (כריסטוס), שפירושה 'המשיח', ומתייחס למלך המשיח המובטח בברית הישנה.

in_greek.name: Χριστός
in_greek.long_meaning: Χριστός είναι το ελληνικό όνομα για τον Ιησού, τον Μεσσία και Σωτήρα. Προέρχεται από το ρήμα 'χρῖσμα' που σημαίνει 'χρίσμα, άγιο λάδι', συμβολίζοντας τη θεία χάρη και την αποστολή του ως Σωτήρα.

in_latin.name: Christus
in_latin.long_meaning: Christus est nomen Latinum pro Iesu, Messia et Salvator. Etymologia nominis 'Christus' a verbo Graeco 'χρῖσμα' derivatur, quod unctionem significat, unctionem olei sancti, qua reges et sacerdotes in populo Dei designabantur.

in_english.name: Kristos
in_english.long_meaning: Kristos, derived from the Greek 'Χριστός' (Christos), means 'Anointed One' or 'Messiah'. It refers to Jesus Christ, the central figure in Christianity, believed to be the savior of humanity. The term 'Christ' is a translation of the Hebrew term 'Mashiach' (Messiah), signifying anointing with holy oil, symbolizing divine appointment and empowerment.

biblical_reference.note: The term 'Christ' or 'Kristos' is used extensively throughout the New Testament to refer to Jesus as the Messiah and Savior.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kristos" has played a significant role in shaping Western civilization. As the title given to Jesus Christ, it has been widely adopted and used in various European languages including Greek, Latin, English, Spanish, Portuguese, and French. Without a doubt, the influence of the name "Kristos" can be seen through the spread of Christianity across the globe, particularly in Europe, and its profound impact on Western culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name "Kristos" represents the Messiah, the Anointed One. This name carries a deep spiritual significance within the faith as it underscores the belief that Jesus Christ is the long-awaited Savior and Redeemer of humanity. Through the name "Kristos," Christians acknowledge Jesus as the Divine Intercessor who offers salvation and forgiveness to all who believe. Jesus' sacrifice, as the Anointed One, transcends human understanding, bridging the gap between God and man. Overall, the name "Kristos" encapsulates the Christian belief in the incarnation of God and the redemptive power of Jesus Christ.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Christian name derived from the Greek word for 'Christ'. The name Kristos carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Common in Eastern Orthodox and Greek Catholic Churches
modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Kristos' is a direct reference to the Christian faith, and is often used in personal names in Eastern Orthodox and Greek Catholic Churches. In modern times, it has also been used as a given name in various other Christian denominations.
